name: perf_profiling
description: Measure and reduce response time and resource use: run the benchmark harness, capture P50/P95/P99 latencies, profile hot paths, find N+1 and serial-when-parallel patterns, and validate optimizations against baseline. Use when something is slow (JARVIS replies, tool dispatch, browser startup) or before/after an optimization pass. Built around the repo's benchmark/ harness (orbit_timing, startup probe, gate).
